result.summary: The page appears to be rendering correctly with no visual defects. All elements are properly aligned, text is legible, images load correctly, and interactive states (like the selected 'All' chip and active 'Home' nav item) are clearly indicated. The only clipped content visible is the last item in the horizontal restaurant row and the bottom pizza card, both of which are explicitly excluded from reporting as they represent standard scrollable/list behavior at viewport edges.
